purpose: Qualify the smallest Lotus surface that can render a declarative visualization in Obsidian without treating Lotus as an execution runtime, knowledge owner, persistence owner or authority surface.

facts: lotus-display source is parsed with JSON.parse into MIME display records
the Markdown lotus-display processor calls renderDisplayOutput directly
the lotus-display processor is registered independently of runBlock and ensureExecutionEnabled
upstream managed-output tests round-trip one or more MIME display records

observed_shape.behavior: renderer constructs SVG through bundled D3 from declarative values; no JavaScript from the display payload is evaluated

cytoscape_renderer.reason: The renderer treats the JSON payload as a partial CytoscapeOptions object and forwards options such as style and layout. A Pantheon profile would need an explicit allowlisted projection before this surface is qualified.

excluded_surfaces: Cytoscape display until a restricted payload contract is demonstrated

candidate_profile.name: renderer_only_d3
candidate_profile.input_surface: fenced lotus-display JSON already present in an authorized Markdown note

payload_contract.custom_color: omit in the first profile; use renderer default

candidate_profile.workspace_write_boundary: Creating or replacing a lotus-display fence is a separate workspace persistence action and requires explicit authorized workspace-persistence intent. Rendering an existing fence is read-only.
projection_boundary: rendered node or edge != governed relation

cases.expected: Existing lotus-display JSON can enter the display renderer through the Markdown processor without executing a fenced code runner.
Local execution, auto-run, API, logging and note write-back remain disabled while an existing declarative display is rendered.
A D3 bar, line or scatter payload renders from JSON only and does not evaluate JavaScript carried in the display payload.
The Pantheon profile refuses HTML, Graphviz, JSXGraph, Plotly and unrestricted Cytoscape MIME records even though Lotus may support them globally.
Rendering an already-present lotus-display fence does not rewrite the Markdown note or create output files.
A successful visualization remains a projection only and does not promote graph structure, claims, Evidence or professional status.

execution_gate.source_review_can_prove: A declarative lotus-display path exists in the reviewed source, D3 consumes a bounded JSON chart shape, and risky execution/write features are disabled by current defaults.
execution_gate.source_review_cannot_prove: That the installed Obsidian release renders the fixture correctly, stays mutation-free under the target configuration, or remains safe after configuration drift.
execution_gate.required_before_register_placement: Run the renderer_only_d3 cases in an isolated Obsidian test vault using release 1.2.3, retain screenshots/log-free observations and before/after note hashes, then review the result before adding Lotus to the external-tool placement register.
execution_gate.forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat source review, upstream smoke CI, plugin installation or successful rendering as provider-wide approval, execution authorization, Evidence or a canonical graph binding.
